import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
p=Path('zoom/readings.json');r=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else []
for pair in sys.argv[1].split():
 b,a=pair.split('/');r.append([b,a])
p.write_text(json.dumps(r))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for it,(b,a) in zip(items,r):
  low='?' in b+a;b=b.replace('?','');a=a.replace('?','')
  b={'n':'none','s':'smooth','r':'rough','u':'unreadable'}[b];a={'n':'none','a':'acute','g':'grave','c':'circumflex','u':'unreadable'}[a]
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=it['item_id'],breathing=next(k for k,v in it['breathing_options'].items() if v==b),accent=next(k for k,v in it['accent_options'].items() if v==a),confidence='low' if low else 'high',note=''))+'\n')
print(len(r))
